objective: Make a server-confirmed weekly Home Dugtong appear beneath the tip on subsequent loads, with private edit and explicit Wall sharing.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main source f635a7b31d249842add00fa9d1425bb06c76b610 inspected 2026-11-10; BUKLOD canonical Supabase project yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu read-only checks confirm two saved 2026-11-09 Dugtong entries and one exact match to reported user-supplied text, 12 enabled weekly tips, both RPCs, active reward rules and RLS. These checks establish source and backend state only, not an installed-app fingerprint or deployed Expo update.
chosenApproach: Render the saved per-user my_dugtong from the existing read RPC in Home, confirm the write RPC before displaying new content, then refresh; support changes and cancel editing. Existing Write, Points, Wall composition and Supabase schema stay intact.
selectionRationale: The persisted content already exists; the issue is a missing UI read presentation. A single-component display fix prevents accidental public disclosure and avoids unnecessary schema/ledger changes.
alternativeApproaches: Publishing all private reflections as public comments was rejected because that changes privacy and requires explicit consent.
Duplicating content into a new table was rejected because it would cause divergent state.
Selected: show the existing saved content privately in the Home card and keep explicit Share to Wall.
acceptanceChecks: Existing Dugtong from get_buklod_weekly_tip_v1 is displayed under the weekly tip on reopen.
Successful save makes the entry visible after server acknowledgement, even when immediate read refresh fails.
Edit/cancel and unchanged-content controls keep the user informed without duplicate write spam.
No public post is made automatically; only explicit Share to Wall opens the existing composer.
Same existing verified BP award and RLS guarantees; no database writes, no rule modifications.
Source regression contracts, TS check and consolidated release gates pass before OTA.
Whitelist this same-repository PR only for existing compile-only Android/Web RC QA; never publish as part of CI.
preserveBehaviors: Read-only privacy of per-user reflections enforced by existing Supabase RLS; no user enumeration.
Existing first reaction +1 BP and first meaningful Dugtong +2 BP weekly; repeat saves give no new credit.
All public Wall, notifications, ads, Clan/Cluster scope, Kingdom and Connect flows unchanged.
Android native runtime, Play package and current production OTA remain unchanged until RC verification.
